title: Orsen and the Cipher
author: Sebastian Pemberton
blurb: Ada Voss, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
